pitcairn.title: Flag of the Pitcairn Islands

countryData.name: Pitcairn Islands
countryData.officialName: Pitcairn, Henderson, Ducie and Oeno Islands

colors.note: British Blue Ensign; the Pacific Ocean.
The anchor and Bible on the coat of arms.

desc:
- The flag of the Pitcairn Islands is a Blue Ensign with the Union Jack in the canton and the Pitcairn coat of arms in the fly — a shield showing the Bible and anchor from HMS Bounty on a green triangle
- Adopted on 2 April 1984, the coat of arms represents the islands' unique history: the Bounty mutineers and their Tahitian companions who founded the settlement in 1790
- The Bible was brought by Fletcher Christian
- **Construction:** British Blue Ensign format with the coat of arms in the fly half
- The shield features a green triangle with an anchor and Bible
- Ratio 1:2
trivia:
- Pitcairn Islands use the Union Jack as they are a British Overseas Territory
- One of the least populated territories in the world
- The inhabitants are primarily descendants of HMS Bounty mutineers
